packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript below 7 until typescript-eslint supports it (its peer range is <6.1.0 and lint crashes on TS 7). Remove once https://github.com/typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint/issues/12518 is resolved.

Hold the Postgres image below 19 until Render offers Postgres 19, so local dev (compose.yml) stays on the same major as production. Remove once Render supports Postgres 19. See https://github.com/mrmeyers99/chorgie/pull/89.
